sāmānyamukhāyāmapi samīhāyāṃ kaścideva viśeṣaḥ samīhitaḥ, 
phalato yo'sau viśeṣāntaratiraskāreṇa udyan dṛśyate | tadamunā 
prakāreṇa yadyapi sāmānyaṃ samīhitam, tathāpi svātmavartī yo 
vyāhārābhāso vyāharāmi- ityevaṃrūpaḥ,

sa satyaṃ samīhājanyatvena prasiddhaḥ | yattu anumātṛsaṃmato

viśeṣarūpam; tat kasya janyaṃ bhavet | na caitrasya, na maitrasya, dvayorapi
